title: Check Desk provider-level fee facts
description: One row per published fee or official 'no national price' statement. Do not invent ranges. Quote official wording in official_wording when possible.

provider.description: Brand or agency, e.g. usps, walmart, king_soopers, western_union, moneygram, ace_cash_express.

fee_amount_min.description: Numeric amount when the official page publishes one number or the low end of a published range. Null if unpublished.

fee_amount_max.description: Same as min for a single figure; high end if the official page publishes a maximum (e.g. Walmart '$4 maximum').

conditions.description: What the fee applies to (amount tiers, check type, loyalty card, payment method).

geography.description: national, state:CO, or a tighter area if the official page is that specific.

official_wording.description: Verbatim or closely quoted official sentence(s).

verification_status.description: For national policy rows this is usually policy_only_call_ahead (chain or program policy, not a store).

published_fee.description: Human-readable published fee as it should appear in a table: an official figure, official maximum, official range, or 'Not published, call ahead'.

limits.description: Amount caps or 'not stated on the official page'.

accepted_check_types.description: Only what the official page lists, or 'not stated on the official page'.

id_rules.description: Only what the official page lists, or 'not stated on the official page'.

hours_note.description: Official national or chain hours language, clearly labeled as not a specific store's hours.
